correctness.rationale: Explicit cyclic Green kernel solves the massive Laplacian recurrence with sum 1/m. The graph Laplacian splits orthogonally into constant and zero-sum clique sectors, yielding both signed edge-column profiles. Exact absolute-value sums and the 1+||Qe||_1-2Q_ee complementary-projection identity give four orbit formulas. Elementary lower bounds on the Green profile prove strict rim domination. The remaining projector comparison simplifies to -1+2/(mn)+2(m-1)R0; exact rational n=5,6 values plus monotonicity settle m=3 and an elementary inequality settles m>=4. Uniform fixed-m cutoff estimates give the same sharp log(n)/n coefficient for both norms. The standalone rational checker reconstructs every projection column on seven graphs (398 columns total); numerical evidence is explicitly non-exhaustive.

value.rationale: This is a natural infinite two-parameter Banach-space projection invariant for cyclic clique products, distinguishing two graph-edge orbits and proving a uniform strict orbit law. The exact m=3 reversal between rim lengths five and six and non-reversal for m>=4 are structural rather than mere computations. Both complementary projection norms share a precise Green-screening log(n)/n correction at fixed m. The theorem advances known circular-ladder and all-complete-factor examples without asserting global minimality.
